{{Household Cyclopedia}}

==Ingredients==
*25 small live [[Cookbook:Oyster|oyster]]s
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
#Rinse the oysters in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]] and drain well.
#Put the live oysters in the shell in a large [[Cookbook:Sauté pan|sauté pan]] on medium-high heat and leave them till their shells open a little.
#Take them off the heat, open them on a plate, and season with salt and pepper.

[[Category:Recipes using oyster]]
